name.value: Top of The Hill Grocery & Gas Bar

description.value: Top of the Hill is a convenience store and gas bar perched at the top of Wildwood Hill in Powell River, strategically positioned as the last major resupply point for cyclists heading north toward Lund. Beyond fuel and snacks, the business has evolved into a surprisingly broad one-stop shop, now offering a deli with fresh sandwiches and pizza, RV repairs, solar equipment, and a showroom featuring e-bikes and scooters. For touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast route, it offers a rare combination of food, fuel, and cycling-adjacent services in a single stop.
